title: Nexus CoreServiceDiscovery
description: Closed v1 service discovery record published to <user_home>/.nexus42/run/service.json and emitted as the single NEXUS_SERVICE_READY stdout line. Carries no API key or bearer secret; identity/epoch is compared against authenticated runtime status before attach or stop. Shell-vs-ready is structural: a ready record carries non-null creator_id, workspace_slug and engine_epoch; an uninitialized shell carries all three as null.

ready.title: ReadyServiceDiscovery
ready.description: Ready record: the core is initialized, so selected creator/workspace identity and the engine epoch are all present.

creator_id.description: Selected creator id; present on every ready record, null only on the uninitialized shell.

workspace_slug.description: Selected workspace slug; present on every ready record, null only on the uninitialized shell.

engine_epoch.description: Monotonic engine epoch; present on every ready record, null until the core is initialized.

readiness.description: Ready: domain surface is served. An explicit shell uses the uninitialized variant instead.

uninitialized.title: UninitializedServiceDiscovery
uninitialized.description: Uninitialized shell: explicit, not a promise of domain readiness; creator/workspace/epoch identity is null.

creator_id.description: Null: an uninitialized shell has no selected creator.

workspace_slug.description: Null: an uninitialized shell has no selected workspace.

engine_epoch.description: Null: the engine epoch does not exist until the core is initialized.

readiness.description: Uninitialized is an explicit shell, not a promise of domain readiness.

instance_id.description: Random per-start instance identity. Attach and stop must match it against the authenticated runtime; a stale record never authorizes signaling a PID.

pid.description: Owning process id, diagnostic only. Never a stop authorization.

user_home.description: Canonical raw user home; home-layout appends .nexus42 exactly once. Mismatched home never attaches.

endpoint.description: Tagged endpoint: http URL or unix absolute socket path. The closed union rejects ambiguous URL/socket combinations.

url.description: Base URL served by the service.

tls_fingerprint.description: TLS certificate fingerprint for https endpoints; null when TLS is unused.
